page.overview:
Who is Dialtone?

Dialtone was in the command room of the Pit locating the missiles for General Hawk while the GI Joe team was attacking the MARS base under the Arctic and Ripcord was destroying the nanomite missiles before they reached and hit their targets.

Dialtone is part of the Joes's support staff. Her data file states that her real name is "Jill J. Morelli," and that she took over her brother's post on the team after he disappeared on a mission.

A toy of the female version of Dialtone was released in a Desert Troop Builder 5-Pack exclusive to Toys R Us stores in 2009. Category:Female Characters Category:Movie characters Category:Image Needed
